mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id as employeeId, username, password, role FROM `user` WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT id, employee_id, username, password, role FROM `user` WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT e.id, e.name, e.email, e.phone, e.department_id AS departmentId, e.position_id AS positionId, d.name AS departmentName, p.title AS positionTitle, e.status FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN e_position p ON e.position_id = p.id;

SELECT e.id, e.name, e.email, coalesce( u.username,"Not Set")as acc, coalesce(d.name,"Not Set")as role FROM employee e join department d on e.department_id = d.id left JOIN user u ON e.id = u.employee_id;
SELECT u.id, e.id, e.name, u.role FROM employee e JOIN user u ON e.id = u.employee_id;
select ut.id as taskId,ut.user_id as userId,ut.description as Description,ut.report_type,ut. dueDate as DueDate ,ut.timeRange as TimeRange from userTask ut join user u where u.id = ut.user_id;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee(name, email, phone, department_id, position_id, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{departmentId}, #{positionId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET name = #{name}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, department_id = #{departmentId}, position_id = #{positionId}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
